newsitem.title: JAPAN: US confident will win Japan WTO film case-official.
newsitem.headline: US confident will win Japan WTO film case-official.

text.p: The United States is confident it will win its case at the World Trade Organisation (WTO) alleging that Japan has attempted to thwart foreign entry into its photographic film and paper market, a U.S. embassy official said on Thursday.
"We have a strong case, we are confident of winning," the official told reporters, adding that Washington expected a WTO panel to rule in October in its favour.
He said that the decision would require significant changes in Japan's distribution system and perhaps in the way its government relates to business.

The United States last week filed a complaint with the WTO alleging that for the last 30 years Japan has imposed laws, regulations and administrative steps to strengthen its domestic industry and curtail opportunities for foreign firms.
Washington says the dispute is not a fight between two competitors -- Eastman Kodak Co and Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd -- but a trade dispute between two countries.
The official said a WTO decision in Washington's favour would affect not only photo film and paper, but virtually all consumer goods.
"It's hard to imagine how that could be limited to any one product," he said.
